mapper.select: SELECT ls.id AS "id", ls.schedule_date AS "scheduleDate", (SELECT cln.name FROM clients cln WHERE cln.client_code = ls.client_code LIMIT 1) AS "clientName", (SELECT CASE WHEN pdn.spec IS NOT NULL AND pdn.spec != '' THEN pdn.name || '(' || pdn.spec || ')' ELSE pdn.name END FROM products pdn WHERE pdn.code = ls.product_code) AS "productName", COALESCE(ls.actual_qty, ls.order_qty) AS "orderQty", ls.order_qty AS "plannedQty", ls.actual_qty AS "actualQty", ls.note AS "note", ls.ship_note AS "shipNote", ls.lot_id AS "lotId", COALESCE((SELECT ci.item_nm FROM tb_common_code_item ci JOIN tb_common_code_group cg ON cg.common_code_group_id = ci.group_id AND cg.group_code = 'VEHICLE_INFO' JOIN tb_tenant ct ON ct.tenant_id = cg.tenant_id AND ct.tenant_code = 'SONGYEON' WHERE ci.item_code = ls.vehicle LIMIT 1), ls.vehicle) AS "vehicle", COALESCE((SELECT ci.item_nm FROM tb_common_code_item ci JOIN tb_common_code_group cg ON cg.common_code_group_id = ci.group_id AND cg.group_code = 'PACKING_TYPE' JOIN tb_tenant ct ON ct.tenant_id = cg.tenant_id AND ct.tenant_code = 'SONGYEON' WHERE ci.item_code = ls.packing_method LIMIT 1), ls.packing_method) AS "packingMethod", ls.visit_order AS "visitOrder", (SELECT emp.name FROM employees emp WHERE emp.id = ls.driver_id LIMIT 1) AS "driverName", ls.charter_info AS "charterInfo", ls.charter_amount AS "charterAmount", ls.ship_confirmed AS "shipConfirmed", ls.box_qty AS "boxQty", ls.sort_order AS "sortOrder", ls.created_at AS "createdAt", ps.schedule_date AS "lotDate", ps.lot_no AS "lotNo", ps.actual_qty AS "lotActualQty", ps.order_qty AS "lotPlannedQty" FROM logistics_schedule ls LEFT JOIN production_schedule ps ON ps.id = ls.lot_id WHERE ls.schedule_date = #{date} ORDER BY ls.sort_order, ls.id

SELECT a.shipment_id AS "shipmentId", a.qty AS "qty", p.lot_no AS "lotNo", p.schedule_date AS "lotDate" FROM shipment_lot_allocation a LEFT JOIN production_schedule p ON p.id = a.lot_id WHERE a.shipment_table = 'logistics_schedule' ORDER BY p.schedule_date, a.id

SELECT id AS "id", logistics_date AS "scheduleDate", (SELECT cln.name FROM clients cln WHERE cln.client_code = production_schedule.client_code LIMIT 1) AS "clientName", (SELECT CASE WHEN pdn.spec IS NOT NULL AND pdn.spec != '' THEN pdn.name || '(' || pdn.spec || ')' ELSE pdn.name END FROM products pdn WHERE pdn.code = production_schedule.product_code) AS "productName", COALESCE(logistics_actual_qty, actual_qty, order_qty) AS "orderQty", order_qty AS "plannedQty", logistics_actual_qty AS "actualQty", note AS "note", ship_note AS "shipNote", COALESCE((SELECT ci.item_nm FROM tb_common_code_item ci JOIN tb_common_code_group cg ON cg.common_code_group_id = ci.group_id AND cg.group_code = 'VEHICLE_INFO' JOIN tb_tenant ct ON ct.tenant_id = cg.tenant_id AND ct.tenant_code = 'SONGYEON' WHERE ci.item_code = ship_vehicle LIMIT 1), ship_vehicle) AS "vehicle", COALESCE((SELECT ci.item_nm FROM tb_common_code_item ci JOIN tb_common_code_group cg ON cg.common_code_group_id = ci.group_id AND cg.group_code = 'PACKING_TYPE' JOIN tb_tenant ct ON ct.tenant_id = cg.tenant_id AND ct.tenant_code = 'SONGYEON' WHERE ci.item_code = ship_packing_method LIMIT 1), ship_packing_method) AS "packingMethod", visit_order AS "visitOrder", (SELECT emp.name FROM employees emp WHERE emp.id = driver_id LIMIT 1) AS "driverName", charter_info AS "charterInfo", charter_amount AS "charterAmount", ship_confirmed AS "shipConfirmed", box_qty AS "boxQty", schedule_date AS "lotDate", lot_no AS "lotNo", actual_qty AS "lotActualQty", order_qty AS "lotPlannedQty" FROM production_schedule WHERE logistics_date = #{date} ORDER BY id
SELECT DISTINCT lot_id FROM logistics_schedule WHERE lot_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT name AS "name", spec AS "spec", COALESCE((SELECT i.item_nm FROM tb_common_code_item i JOIN tb_common_code_group g ON g.common_code_group_id = i.group_id AND g.group_code = 'STORAGE_METHOD' JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND t.tenant_code = 'SONGYEON' WHERE i.item_code = storage LIMIT 1), storage) AS "storage", stock_qty AS "stockQty" FROM products
SELECT name FROM employees WHERE name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY department, name
SELECT id FROM employees WHERE name = #{name} ORDER BY id LIMIT 1

SELECT i.item_code FROM tb_common_code_item i JOIN tb_common_code_group g ON g.common_code_group_id = i.group_id AND g.group_code = #{groupCode} JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = g.tenant_id AND t.tenant_code = 'SONGYEON' WHERE i.item_nm = #{name} ORDER BY CASE WHEN i.use_at = 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, i.sort_order, i.item_code LIMIT 1

choose.when: SELECT id AS "id", ship_confirmed AS "shipConfirmed", product_code AS "productCode", (SELECT CASE WHEN pdn.spec IS NOT NULL AND pdn.spec != '' THEN pdn.name || '(' || pdn.spec || ')' ELSE pdn.name END FROM products pdn WHERE pdn.code = production_schedule.product_code) AS "productName", (SELECT cln.name FROM clients cln WHERE cln.client_code = production_schedule.client_code LIMIT 1) AS "clientName", logistics_date AS "movedOn", logistics_actual_qty AS "logisticsActualQty", actual_qty AS "actualQty", order_qty AS "orderQty", id AS "lotId", box_qty AS "boxQty" FROM production_schedule WHERE id = #{id}
choose.otherwise: SELECT id AS "id", ship_confirmed AS "shipConfirmed", product_code AS "productCode", (SELECT CASE WHEN pdn.spec IS NOT NULL AND pdn.spec != '' THEN pdn.name || '(' || pdn.spec || ')' ELSE pdn.name END FROM products pdn WHERE pdn.code = logistics_schedule.product_code) AS "productName", (SELECT cln.name FROM clients cln WHERE cln.client_code = logistics_schedule.client_code LIMIT 1) AS "clientName", schedule_date AS "movedOn", actual_qty AS "actualQty", order_qty AS "orderQty", lot_id AS "lotId", box_qty AS "boxQty" FROM logistics_schedule WHERE id = #{id}

mapper.select: SELECT a.lot_id AS "lotId", a.qty AS "qty", p.lot_no AS "lotNo", p.schedule_date AS "lotDate" FROM shipment_lot_allocation a LEFT JOIN production_schedule p ON p.id = a.lot_id WHERE a.shipment_table = 'logistics_schedule' AND a.shipment_id = #{shipmentId} ORDER BY p.schedule_date, a.id
SELECT code FROM products WHERE CASE WHEN spec IS NOT NULL AND spec != '' THEN name || '(' || spec || ')' ELSE COALESCE(name, '') END = #{displayName} ORDER BY code LIMIT 1
SELECT lot_no FROM production_schedule WHERE id = #{id}

choose.when: UPDATE production_schedule SET logistics_actual_qty = #{actualQty} WHERE id = #{id}
choose.otherwise: UPDATE logistics_schedule SET actual_qty = #{actualQty} WHERE id = #{id}

choose.when: UPDATE production_schedule SET box_qty = #{boxQty, jdbcType=DOUBLE} WHERE id = #{id}
choose.otherwise: UPDATE logistics_schedule SET box_qty = #{boxQty, jdbcType=DOUBLE} WHERE id = #{id}

choose.when: UPDATE production_schedule SET ship_vehicle = #{row.vehicle}, ship_packing_method = #{row.packingMethod}, ship_note = #{row.shipNote}, visit_order = #{row.visitOrder, jdbcType=INTEGER}, driver_id = #{row.driverId}, charter_info = #{row.charterInfo}, charter_amount = #{row.charterAmount, jdbcType=DOUBLE}, ship_confirmed = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
choose.otherwise: UPDATE logistics_schedule SET vehicle = #{row.vehicle}, packing_method = #{row.packingMethod}, ship_note = #{row.shipNote}, visit_order = #{row.visitOrder, jdbcType=INTEGER}, driver_id = #{row.driverId}, charter_info = #{row.charterInfo}, charter_amount = #{row.charterAmount, jdbcType=DOUBLE}, ship_confirmed = 1 WHERE id = #{id}

choose.when: UPDATE production_schedule SET ship_confirmed = 0 WHERE id = #{id}
choose.otherwise: UPDATE logistics_schedule SET ship_confirmed = 0 WHERE id = #{id}

mapper.select: SELECT id AS "id", actual_qty AS "actualQty", (SELECT CASE WHEN pdn.spec IS NOT NULL AND pdn.spec != '' THEN pdn.name || '(' || pdn.spec || ')' ELSE pdn.name END FROM products pdn WHERE pdn.code = production_schedule.product_code) AS "productName", product_code AS "productCode", schedule_date AS "scheduleDate", (SELECT cln.name FROM clients cln WHERE cln.client_code = production_schedule.client_code LIMIT 1) AS "clientName", order_qty AS "orderQty" FROM production_schedule WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE production_schedule SET actual_qty = #{actualQty} WHERE id = #{id}

choose.otherwise: SELECT schedule_date AS "scheduleDate", charter_info AS "charterInfo", charter_amount AS "charterAmount" FROM logistics_schedule WHERE ship_confirmed = 1 AND schedule_date BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} AND ((charter_info IS NOT NULL AND charter_info != '') OR (charter_amount IS NOT NULL AND charter_amount != 0))
